comment: The maker configures the left output twice and the right output not at all, so Rack shows the tooltip "Right" on the left jack and no name on the right one; the code writes the left channel to the first jack and the right channel to the second. The frame size parameter has no widget on the panel. The panning read at the output is indexed by overlapping frame rather than by frequency band, so only the four lowest bands of the PANNING grid reach the output at all.
